title: erysimum tortuosum
intro: Erysimum tortuosum, commonly known as perennial wallflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum tortuosum include its antiseptic and antiviral effects, making it useful for wound healing and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
